title: WorldBridge: Bridging Video and Action for Task Generalization in World Action Models
description:
arXiv:2610.40748v1 Announce Type: new 
Abstract: Achieving the broad task generalization of embodied models in physical environments remains a central challenge in robot learning. We study this challenge in World Action Models (WAMs) through two complementary capabilities: video generalization, which predicts the visual evolution of new tasks, and action generalization, which translates these predictions into executable behavior through a video-to-action bridge.
